rules.text: Under Pakistan NHMP Motorway rules, what is the maximum speed limit for motor cars on M-2 Motorway under clear weather?
rules.explanation: The National Highways and Motorway Police (NHMP) regulates the maximum speed limit for private passenger cars on M-2 at 120 km/h.

rules.text: What traffic rule applies to driving on Pakistan public roads regarding lane position?
options: Drive on the left side of the road and overtake on the right.
Drive on the right side of the road and overtake on the left.
Drive in whatever lane has the fewest potholes.
Overtaking on the left shoulder is legally permitted.
rules.explanation: Pakistan follows left-hand traffic (LHT). Vehicles must keep to the left side of the road and overtake on the right.
